999008199.text: （攫われただけで襲っては来ないみたいだけど……）

localizations.en: They just kidnapped me, but they don't seem like they're going to attack...

999008199.text: ひぅっ！　怖いものは怖いよぅ……

（そういえば、一人きりになったのって
　本当に久しぶりなんだ）

localizations.en: Come to think of it, it's been a really long time since I've been all by myself.

999008199.text:
（この世界に来てからも、イクセくんやみんな、
　誰かしらそばにいてくれたから寂しくなかったっけ）

localizations.en: Ever since I came to this world, Iksel and everyone else have always been there with me, so I never felt lonely.

999008199.text:
お話の中のお姫様も、
攫われてこんな気持ちだったのかなぁ

localizations.en: I wonder if the princess in the story felt like this when she was kidnapped too?

999008199.text: （今はわたしがそのお姫様の役）

localizations.en: Right now, I'm playing that princess's role.

999008199.text:
（このお姫様は、どんな気持ちだったんだろう？
　……日記を読んでみよう）

localizations.en: What was this princess feeling? ...Let me read her diary.

999008199.text:
お姫様は義理のお姉さんの妬みを買ってしまった。
身に覚えがないって戸惑ってる……

localizations.en: The princess earned her stepsister's jealousy. She's confused because she doesn't know why...

999008199.text:
それで城でもいないもののように扱われて……
そんな生活が苦しくて、自分から逃げ出した……え？

localizations.en: And then she was treated like she didn't exist at the castle... That life was so painful that she ran away on her own... Huh?

999008199.text:
お姫様、城から追い出されたんじゃなくて、
自分から逃げ出したんだ

localizations.en: The princess wasn't kicked out of the castle—she ran away herself.

999008199.text:
温かい人たちとの生活に憧れてて、村の人たちとも
いつかは仲良くなりたいって書かれてる……

localizations.en: She longed for a life with caring people, and she wrote that she wanted to become friends with the villagers someday...

999008199.text:
（でもこのお話では、探しに来てくれた騎士と
　再会しても魔物に攫われて）

localizations.en: But in this story, even when the knight came looking for her, she got kidnapped by monsters.

999008199.text:
（村の人たちも、義理のお姉さんの流した噂のせいで
　いなくなっちゃって）

localizations.en: And the villagers disappeared too because of the rumors her stepsister spread.

999008199.text: お姫様に幸せになってほしいなぁ……

localizations.en: I really want the princess to be happy...
